data.summary: Beispiellahn Zeitungsverlag GmbH confirms Johanna Beispielacker's new subscription (Abonummer A-704 118) to the Beispiellahn-Zeitung, including e-paper, starting 1 December 2026 at €42.50 per month, with a minimum term of 12 months.
data.explanation: This letter confirms your subscription (Abonnement) to the Beispiellahn-Zeitung starting 1 December 2026, priced at €42.50 per month and including the e-paper. The subscription runs for an initial 12 months; after that it continues until cancelled with one month's notice. You don't need to do anything right now — the app will track the subscription and show you the cancellation window if you ever want to end it. Keep your Abonummer (A-704 118) handy for any contact with the provider.
